# CLI reference

```text
A tmux-backed command center for running coding agents side by side.

Run `the-deaner` with no arguments to open the sidebar and terminal frame.

Usage: the-deaner [COMMAND]

Commands:
  sidebar        Run the sidebar in the current terminal (the frame runs this for you)
  add            Add repos or folders to the sidebar
  forget         Forget a repo; its sessions keep running and files are untouched
  new            Create a worktree for BRANCH in REPO and start a session for it
  open           Start (or unpark) a workspace and switch to it. A folder that isn't added yet is added first
  tab            Add a tab to a workspace, e.g. `the-deaner tab api claude` or `the-deaner tab api logs -- tail -f app.log`
  archive        Remove a worktree and kill its session
  ls             List workspaces, tabs and agent states
  send           Type a message into another agent's tab and press Enter
  whoami         Print this pane's address, for other agents to `the-deaner send` to
  peek           Show the end of a tab's output in a pager (`v` in the sidebar)
  save           Snapshot all workspaces now
  park           Save a workspace and stop its session; open it again to bring it back
  restore        Rebuild workspaces from the latest snapshot
  shutdown       Done for the day: save everything, then stop all sessions
  install-hooks  Install the-deaner's status hooks into an agent's settings
  browse         Browse folders to pick a project, add it, and open it (`a` in the sidebar)
  cheatsheet     Open the searchable shortcut cheat sheet (Alt-/ inside the-deaner)
  keys           Show keybindings
  config         Show where config and state live, or print the default config
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## the-deaner sidebar

```text
Run the sidebar in the current terminal (the frame runs this for you)

Usage: the-deaner sidebar [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --standalone
          Allow `q` to quit (implied outside the frame)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

```text

```

## the-deaner tab

```text
Add a tab to a workspace, e.g. `the-deaner tab api claude` or `the-deaner tab api logs -- tail -f app.log`

Usage: the-deaner tab <TARGET> <NAME> [-- <COMMAND>...]

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          

  <NAME>
          

  [COMMAND]...
          Command to run in the tab (defaults to the agent of the same name, or a shell)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## the-deaner archive

```text
Remove a worktree and kill its session

Usage: the-deaner archive [OPTIONS] <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          

Options:
      --force
          Remove even with uncommitted changes

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## the-deaner send

```text
Type a message into another agent's tab and press Enter

Usage: the-deaner send [OPTIONS] <ADDR> <TEXT>...

Arguments:
  <ADDR>
          `<session>` or `<session>:<tab>` (see `the-deaner ls`)

  <TEXT>...
          

Options:
      --no-enter
          Type the text without pressing Enter

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## the-deaner install-hooks

```text
Install the-deaner's status hooks into an agent's settings

Usage: the-deaner install-hooks [OPTIONS] [AGENT]

Arguments:
  [AGENT]
          [default: claude]

Options:
      --uninstall
          Remove the-deaner's hooks instead

      --settings <SETTINGS>
          Settings file (default: ~/.claude/settings.json)

      --command <COMMAND>
          How hooks should invoke the-deaner
          
          [default: the-deaner]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
